kjv: to them that are sanctified by God the Father
mine: to those who are … beloved in God the Father
note: TR "hegiasmenois" (sanctified) against "egapemenois" (beloved; P72, Sinaiticus, A, B).

kjv: denying the only Lord God, and our Lord Jesus Christ
mine: deny our only Master and Lord, Jesus Christ
note: TR adds "theon" (God), making two persons; the early text calls Jesus Christ "our only Master and Lord".

kjv: how that the Lord, having saved the people out of the land of Egypt
mine: that Jesus, Who saved a people out of the land of Egypt
note: SBLGNT reads "Iesous" with A, B, 33, 1739 and early versions (TR "kyrios"); the early text names Jesus as Israel's deliverer at the exodus, a strikingly high Christology (cf. 1 Cor 10:4).

kjv: These (the ungodly people) are spots in your feasts of charity
mine: These (the ungodly people) are hidden reefs at your love feasts
note: spilades are submerged rocks that wreck ships; "spots" reads it as "spiloi" (stains, as at 2 Pet 2:13).

kjv: And of some have compassion, making a difference
mine: And have mercy on those who doubt
note: diakrinomenous here means "those who doubt" (as at Jas 1:6), not "making a difference"; the TR also has a two-clause form of 1:22–23 against the three-clause early text.

kjv: To the only wise God our Saviour … both now and ever
mine: to the only God, our Savior, through Jesus Christ our Lord … before all time and now and forever
note: TR adds "sopho" (wise) and omits "dia Iesou Christou tou kyriou hemon" and "pro pantos tou aionos".
